messages:
olivia: Started POC call with Pulsar at 11:30 — they’re doing a lift-and-shift from CompetitorX and their top asks are prompt parity, identical token billing for the trial, and minimal behavior drift. Sending notes + tagging team for quick Q/A.

devin: Main checklist from call: 1) request/response mapping (headers, stop tokens) 2) prompt templating differences (system + user split) 3) token counting mismatch and billing parity. I’ll drop a sample mapping.

devin: ```json
{
  "incoming": {
    "model": "compX-legacy-chat",
    "prompt_field": "input.text",
    "stop_tokens": ["\n\n"],
    "max_tokens": 1024
  },
  "redwood_out": {
    "model": "redwood-chat-v1",
    "messages": [{"role":"system","content":"{{system}}"},{"role":"user","content":"{{input.text}}"}]
  }
}
```

ravi: Perf/ops notes — CompetitorX streams chunked deltas with tiny fragments; our streaming is compatible but default chunking differs. Recommend using our nodelay streaming flag for parity. Also kv-cache warmup behavior differs; for high-session workloads we should pre-warm the cache. Quant-variants can slightly change tokenization on edge cases.

anya: Security checklist: they require SOC2, IP allowlist, customer-managed KMS, SSO (SAML). Pulsar sent a 12-page security questionnaire — forwarding it in a sec. @olivia, do they plan to send PII in prompts? Need clarity for retention/processing terms.

olivia: They said no intentional PII but some user chat may contain names/emails. For the POC they want logs retained for 30 days and encrypted at rest. Can Dedicated be KMS-backed? @ravi

ravi: Yes — Dedicated supports KMS (AES wrapped with customer keys / HSM options). Private deployment supports on-prem keying. Example config snippet: ```yaml
dedicated: 
  kms: 
    provider: customer-kms 
    key_id: projects/123/locations/global/keyRings/ring/cryptoKey/key
```

devin: Token counting detail: CompetitorX does an early whitespace normalization before tokenization; we use a tiktoken-like splitter that counts slightly differently for leading/trailing spaces and repeated newlines. Quick workaround for the POC: canonicalize prompts (collapse multiple spaces/newlines) before sending and add a small shim that mirrors their pre-tokenization rules. That gets billing parity in >95% of cases.

devin: ```python
def normalize_prompt(s):
    import re
    s = re.sub(r"\n{2,}", "\n\n", s)
    s = re.sub(r" {2,}", " ", s)
    return s.strip()
```

olivia: Pricing question from buyer: can we do an "apples-to-apples" token price during the 90-day POC? They want no surprises on billing.

anya: Legal will need a written plan for any temporary pricing adjustments and a clause about fallbacks. Also need confirmation of log retention/retention deletion APIs. @olivia please loop in legal.

olivia: For the POC we offered: 1) billing credit to offset expected delta, 2) invoice adjustment if delta > threshold, 3) clear SOW line for 90-day aligned pricing. I’ll draft an email.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: artifact uploaded -> /pulsar_poc/compat-mapping-v1.pdf :thumbsup:

devin: Next steps (actionable): 1) Send mapping artifact + sample diff harness that runs 100 representative prompts -> outputs + token counts (diff mode). 2) Security answers from Anya + questionnaire. 3) Draft POC SOW with billing credit line. I can have mapping + demo ready EOD tomorrow.

olivia: Thanks — I’ll send to buyer by EOD and schedule follow-up call Thurs 9am PT. @anya please confirm security Qs by EOD today so I can include in the email.

anya: Will do — adding notes about retention windows, log redaction APIs, and SSO workaround. I’ll attach the security answers to the thread when done.
